newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise Feb rubber futures margin fee.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise Feb rubber futures margin fee.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Tuesday that it would raise the margin requirement on its February futures contract by 10,000 yen, effective from Wednesday.
The hike will bring the total February requirement to 72,500 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
The increase was intended to cool overheated trade.
The margin for the January contract will be unchanged at 157,750 yen while the requirement on other rubber contracts will stay at 52,500 yen, TOCOM said.
